OFFICE LEASE AGREEMENT

1. Parties
This lease is made between Harborview Properties LLC as landlord and Contoso Manufacturing Ltd. as tenant for office space on the fourth floor of 200 Market Street.

2. Term
The lease term is five years beginning July 1, 2023.

3. Rent
The monthly rent is $14,500, payable on the first day of each month. A security deposit equal to two months of rent is due at signing.

4. Utilities and Maintenance
The tenant is responsible for electricity, internet and cleaning. The landlord maintains the roof, elevators and heating systems.

5. Termination
Either party may terminate the lease early by giving 90 days written notice and paying a fee equal to three months of rent.
